lessons.title: What time is it?

items.example: Ça marche, nous pouvons partir à 9 heures.
items.exampleMeaning: It works, we can leave at 9 o'clock.

items.example: Je vais maintenant acheter un ticket.
items.exampleMeaning: I will now buy a ticket.

lessons.tip: In French, we use 'Il est' to tell the time. Remember to use the correct hour and add 'heures' for hours.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: À quelle heure commence le bus ?
dialogue.meaning: At what time does the bus start?

scenario.partnerRole: A person at the bus station
scenario.brief: Ask the person at the bus station for the time and when the bus leaves. Listen to their answers.
scenario.goal: You need to find out the bus schedule.

lessons.title: Buying a ticket

items.example: Je voudrais un ticket, s'il vous plaît.
items.exampleMeaning: I would like a ticket, please.

items.example: Un billet, s'il vous plaît, pour Paris.
Je voudrais un aller simple, s'il vous plaît.
items.exampleMeaning: I would like a one-way ticket, please.
Thank you very much for your help!

lessons.tip: When buying a ticket, you can specify if you want a one-way ('aller simple') or round-trip ('aller-retour') ticket. Always remember to say 's'il vous plaît'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Bonjour, je voudrais un ticket, s'il vous plaît.
dialogue.meaning: Hello, I would like a ticket, please.

scenario.brief: Ask the ticket seller for a ticket and its price. Make sure to specify what type of ticket you want.
scenario.goal: You need to buy a ticket.

lessons.title: Using the present tense
lessons.tip: In French, the present tense is formed by using the correct subject pronoun and the verb. For example, 'Je' means 'I', and 'vais' is the form of 'aller' for 'I'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Are you going to the cinema?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Yes, we go to the cinema.

scenario.brief: Ask your friend where they are going and what transport they are taking. Respond with your plans.
scenario.goal: You need to share your travel plans.

lessons.title: Transport plans

items.text: À quelle heure part le train ?
items.meaning: At what time does the train leave?
items.example: À quelle heure part le train pour Paris ?
items.exampleMeaning: At what time does the train to Paris leave?

items.meaning: I am going to take the train.
items.example: Je vais prendre le train à dix heures.
items.exampleMeaning: I am going to take the train at ten o'clock.

items.text: Il y a un bus à... heures.
items.meaning: There is a bus at... o'clock.
items.example: Il y a un bus à cinq heures.
items.exampleMeaning: There is a bus at five o'clock.

items.example: C'est le bon quai pour le train ?
items.exampleMeaning: Is this the right platform for the train?

items.example: Je suis en retard pour le train.
items.exampleMeaning: I am late for the train.

items.example: Aucun souci, je peux t'aider avec ça.
items.exampleMeaning: No problem, I can help you with that.

lessons.tip: When asking about transport times, use 'À quelle heure' for questions. You can also specify the transport type.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: À quelle heure part le train ?
dialogue.meaning: At what time does the train leave?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: I am going to take the train.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Yes, this is the right platform.

scenario.brief: Ask the fellow traveler about the train schedule and confirm the platform. Share your travel plans.
scenario.goal: You need to coordinate your transport plans.
